scope: Proposition 10.2 of the manuscript “Almost-everywhere Fourier convergence in L log L” (preprints/Almost-everywhere-Fourier-convergence-in-L-log-L-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 075 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9a77d41e5b9b9beb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 73. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Every bounded complex-valued periodic function has almost-everywhere conver- gence of its symmetric Fourier partial sums along the full sequence.
